claims.text: Ampere says Magnus Neo delivers 85 km real range vs 118 km IDC.
claims.quote: The Magnus Neo is rated 118 km IDC and delivers 85 km real.

passage.text: test cycles. Real-world range in Bangalore traffic runs well below that due to slow speeds, frequent stops, and quick bursts of acceleration to clear junctions. Ampere publishes both numbers, which makes planning straightforward. The Magnus Neo is rated 118 km IDC and delivers 85 km real. The Magnus G Max is rated 142 km IDC and delivers 100+ km. The Nexus EX+ is rated 136 km IDC and delivers 90+ km. The Reo Vyb covers 80 km real-world. Plan on the real figure, not the lab one.

claims.text: iQube has aggressive regen that takes getting used to.
claims.quote: What will take some getting used to on the iQube is its aggressive motor regen when you shut the throttle.

passage.text: That’s something those new to EVs will like. Eco mode caps the speed to 50kph, which is the typical pace in most cities, while Power mode allows you to hit an indicated 80kph. The ability to hold these speeds means the iQube doesn’t feel out of place on a faster flowing highway as well. What will take some getting used to on the iQube is its aggressive motor regen when you shut the throttle. We think it’s a little too strong and doesn’t feel very natural, although this is something the company can address in a software update.

recommendation.headline: TVS iQube, as a provisional pick on thin evidence
recommendation.summary: The sources give no direct reliability or service-network data for iQube, Ather or Chetak. iQube is leaned towards because it is the only major option with a positive commuter assessment and no documented service problems, while Ola has documented ones.

reasons.text: Autocar describes the iQube as a comfortable, easy-to-ride commuter, a step above the Chetak
Ola has documented service strain, which counts against it on your top priorities

tradeoffs.text: Aggressive regen takes getting used to; claimed range only

alternatives.when: You prioritise handling and can accept a stiff, cramped ride
You want a comfortable commuter and do not need modern features
Budget matters; its range and service figures are vendor claims

caveats: Autocar test is from 2022 in Mumbai
Absence of evidence on iQube service is not evidence of good service
nextSteps: Check Bengaluru service centre density and owner reviews for each brand
Test ride and ask dealers for real range at your route
